reviews.x: These Bows are beautiful - nice and fluffy and the colors are very pretty. Clip is a little large but we have super fine hair so we have to put in a rubber band and clip over for them to stay but works great.
Love these! Very good quality and the exact size I was looking for.

You get what you pay for. 20 bucks for 25 bows- I should of known that they wouldnt be the best quality but I didnt expect them to just be hot glued to the clips though (hot glue just peals away from the metal and the ribbon). As I hung up the bows (hadnt been worn at all)- a few of them started pealing away from the barrette. However, I know for the price I couldn't even buy the ribbon for this many bows. The bows are high-quality and this is a steal for the huge amount of bows you get.... contains just about every color you can imagine! -------------------------------------------- Original review:  These are great for the cost. I normally buy the same size bows at Dillards but they are very pricey. This bag of bows is huge, the c

Okay, let's be honest, these are not the highest quality bows and they will require some fluffing when you take them out of the bag. But, at roughly $0.80/bow, I'm good with that. The colors are beautiful and I don't cringe when my toddler gets tired and yanks her bow out. This is the second set of bows that I've bought from this company, the first being the 5" set which is still in good condition. I've ordered bows from The Solid Bow and I've purchased  boutique bows, but these are by far t

Was surprised at the quality that you get for the price. I have bought similar items that cost more and of poorer quality. The bows are glued on to the clip and in time could melt away and fall apart but it will take time for this to happen. If you have a lot of hair or a little these bows will work for you. Whether you're a child or older, buns or braids, updos or ponytails these items can add a little color and playfullness. There are a variety of colors to match any wardrobe.  Will by more.

The good part - the color selection is great.  The bad part - instead of attaching through the use of a clip as did the package I bought earlier by another company, these bows have very large metal cheap barrettes that are glued to the ribbons making them completely unusable unless it is a little girl with long hair.  They will not work for anyone with short hair, or other hair textures.  What a great disappointment!

reviews.t: Great quality Great price, Best deal your going to find!
reviews.x: Exactly what I wanted!! Great quality, bright, great color bows that go with every thing. I'm so glad I stumbled upon these! These are at a really low price too. For these same bows you'd find at a kiosk in the mall for $3 each You get on here 25 for $20, that's 80 cents each! I will be doing all my future bow purchases from this seller from now on.

I was so afraid I was going to get lousy, silky bows. I’m impressed with the quality. They look like the same bows I would buy down the road at a children’s boutique 🤑 They arrive all in one bag, NOT SMUSHED, in perfect condition. I can’t wait to piece together her outfits now!

reviews.t: I have never been more satisfied with an order
reviews.x: I have never been more satisfied with an order. I am not a crafty person and typically pay  4$ for one hairbow. These averaged out to be about a dollar per bow. And I love that I can always find a color to match her outfit no matter what she wears 😁
These bows are PERFECT and exactly what I was hoping for. They are the perfect size for my 1.5 year old. I love the variety of colors and how big and full they are. Great bows at a great price!

reviews.t: Bows are big and beautiful and included every color and shade you could possibly ...
reviews.x: Bows are big and beautiful and included every color and shade you could possibly need for a young girl. Quality bows and attached to quality clips. My girls are 5 and 3 and love them.

reviews.t: Excellent Quality! The selection of colors is incredible
reviews.x: Excellent Quality ! The selection of colors is incredible.
Great quality! So pleased I bought these!
I love everything about these hair bows.

New review:  I repurchased these bows again for my second granddaughter & they were definitely not what I purchased the first two times!  These are tiny little bows, however she is still very young so thankfully they will work. The amount and colors are good!  Last review:  I had purchased these bows previously for my granddaughter & was so pleased!  They came in a nice, good quality zip lock bag & weren’t smashed, just beautiful! All 25 hairbows (mind you 6” wide bows) were crammed into a 10 3/4” x 15 1/2” zip top bag so as you can imagine, they were all crushed. I tried to fluff them and used a hair straightener on a couple (as recommended in other bow sites) to get the wrinkles out but then they became floppy and looked terrible so are now unusable. I was so pleasantly surprised at how great these bows are! I purchased another set about a year ago from Amazon (same price different seller) and they did not hold up well, sat so that they exposed the metal clip, and did not have a great shape. These new bows are full and pretty, sit just right, and have held up really well! Therr are so many pretty colors, and I also really love the bag they came in! It has been great for storage and travel! I highly recommend these hair bows! You won’t find a

The bows came in creased and wrinkled. They looked absolutely awful. Not one bow would have been ok to use. Two of them fell apart as I was trying to fluff. I ended up using my hair straightener to iron them out. They are EXTREMELY flimsy and don't hold shape very well. These will be play hair bows and I'll purchase a different brand that is better quality. Gave two stars because they were so cheap I won't lose sleep if one gets misplaced or lost.

reviews.t: For the price these bows are pretty good, the only real problem I have is ...
reviews.x: For the price these bows are pretty good, the only real problem I have is that the knot in the middle is loose, my child pulled the bow out of her hair one day and it pulled at the knot.  I can't get the bow to look right now.  Its as if the bow is just looped and the knot holds it, but its not tight enough to truly secure the shape of the bow.  The colors however are a full array and match lots of things.

So, I'm giving these 3 stars because I love how many different colors they have and alot of the darker colors I have a hard time finding. Unfortunately, they aren't the best quality.  At least 6 of them have glue stuck on the bow and 4 of them the clips were glued shut. They are a little smaller then 3 inches, which is annoying but im keeping anyway bc of the colors.

These are so per8! The colors are all so beautiful!  The size is exactly what I was wanting for my 6 year old. My package arrived 14 days before the 1st estimated arrival date which was fantastic! I have already sent the link for these and recommend these to so many other mommas.  I will definitely repurchase these!!

Great Bows, Great Colors!  They have HUGE aligator clips on the back and I was super skeptical they would hold all day at school with as active as my daughter is but they have yet to fall out! I am super excited! She like them because she can put them in herself and they can hold a lot more hair than you would think!

Purchased these for my 23 month old daughter who loves wearing bows to keep her bangs out of her eyes. Great value and quality for the price. I love the shape of these bows verses the pinwheel shape. The full color spectrum is perfect for finding a match to any outfit. The size is also what I expected.

reviews.t: Love bows but tan is missing
reviews.x: My bows are beautiful but I am missing the tan bow.... I don’t want to return the entire set but I would like to be sent my tan bow. Could someone please contact me to have this arranged? there is no option from my side except to return the entire set (which I would prefer not to do)

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the wide variety of colors included in the set.
Many customers consider the bows a great value for the low price per bow.
Most reviewers describe the bows as good or excellent quality.
Some reviewers note the bows are glued to the clips and worry they may fall apart over time.
A few customers mention the clips are large or that the bows require fluffing out of the bag.
